description: This PHP source file defines the 'Email' class within the SuiteCRM project, handling email-related functionalities including sending, receiving, attachment management, email address normalization, and database interactions for storing and retrieving email data.

classes.name: Email
classes.description: Represents an email entity within SuiteCRM, encapsulating email data, behaviors for sending, retrieving, attaching files, and database interaction methods.

classes.name: Email
classes.description: Represents an email entity within SuiteCRM, handling email data, composition, retrieval, sending, attachment management, address parsing, validation, and database interactions. It encompasses methods for email lifecycle operations, attachment processing, status management, and integration with system configurations and protocols.
